title: workiva_content_placement output
description: Proposed closed output contract. Authorization and ownership precede disclosure. Only an initial successful stage response may carry a raw confirmation token as an ephemeral overlay. Saved responses and replays are token-free. Unknown possible effects use uncertain, never an ordinary error or retryable response.

no_mutation_submitted.description: Describes this invocation. Reconcile and replay never submit a mutation, even when inspecting a previously submitted operation.

sourceBinding.description: content_hash is server-computed SHA-256 of the exact immutable received bytes; source_text is encoded as received UTF-8 without normalization.

verifiedEvidenceRef.description: Server-resolved immutable saved machine evidence, owned by the authenticated workflow actor. The server must verify operation/verification/workflow associations before materialization or disclosure; model claims cannot establish verification.

oneOf.description: Closed immutable mixed lineage. Runtime verifies source/evidence ownership and that repeated bindings match the exact server-resolved inputs.

sourceArtifact.description: content_hash hashes the actual immutable received source bytes; no alternate sha256 alias is emitted.

ingestResult.description: A source-null result is the refs-only path: an owned workflow_context and verified saved evidence are required at ingress. No source artifact or extraction is fabricated. With a source, drafts may preserve source-only or mixed source-plus-evidence lineage. Returned bindings must match server-resolved inputs.

interpretation.description: Null means explicitly reviewed not-applicable, never unknown. Scales express verified multipliers relative to the named base unit. Missing or ambiguous applicable facts block staging; numeric/date/boolean/type and same-currency conversion consistency require semantic validation.

destinationProfile.description: Normative operator-authored payload carried by an authenticated signed bundle; not a chat-supplied mapping. Tenant comes from the containing bundle. content_hash is SHA-256 of versioned canonical profile bytes excluding its content_hash member. Signature verification, active-bundle membership, immutable revision/hash consistency, reference resolution, retention and authorization are runtime prerequisites. Unknown critical metadata blocks the affected stage. No formula, layout, multi-cell or bulk operation exists in this schema.

location.description: Byte offsets are half-open in original source bytes. Runtime checks end > start, source length, UTF-8 boundaries and independently established location validity; no invented coordinates.

mixedProvenance.description: Preserves source provenance and the immutable verified evidence references. Runtime checks each against preview lineage.

metadataFact.description: Operator declarations are template constraints, not observations of provider enforcement. The profile determines criticality and allowed provenance; callers cannot downgrade a critical fact. Runtime compares each fact against the frozen interpretation and signed metadata requirement.

providerFacts.description: Required provider evidence, not inferred from a successful read, operator declaration or confirmation. Absence or uncertainty prevents a successful stage.

preview.description: Exact authorized preview, never truncated. Binds the original item/draft text, source bytes or saved verified evidence, interpretations, current target and intended literal, signed policies/profile, actor and expiry. Runtime enforces equality of repeated bindings, value/type/interpretation consistency, allowed conversion, provider provenance requirements, byte caps and 0 < expiry-created <= profile.preview_ttl_seconds. No FX inference or double scaling. Unknown applicable critical facts block staging.

operationBinding.description: Preserve the already known provider operation ID exactly. operation_known may be false only when no ID has ever been established; runtime must compare persisted history. It cannot be reset to discard a known operation.

ackResult.description: Human visual observation is separate from machine verification and never authorizes another submission.

reconcileResult.description: Classification never reopens confirmation. Proof/readback references must resolve to authenticated immutable evidence for this intent, uncertainty episode and preserved operation. confirmed_not_applied never permits repeat submission.

error.description: Safe fixed-vocabulary error. Messages and field paths must not contain private bodies, artifact existence clues, credentials, raw tokens or sensitive provider payloads. retryable=true requires proven pre-effect transience.
